prompt: In a photorealistic photo, the scene unfolds within a vintage train dining car where eighteen distinct entities are arranged. On the left, a man in a red scarf sits on a velvet bench, his posture slumped slightly as he holds a silver spoon. Next to him rests a brown leather suitcase, its brass latches gleaming under the overhead lights. A woman in a blue hat looks at the man in the red scarf, her eyes wide with curiosity. She points at a white porcelain cup sitting on the polished mahogany table between them. The cup contains dark coffee, steam rising gently from its surface. Beside the cup lies a folded newspaper, its headlines partially visible. In the center, a waiter in a black vest stands upright, balancing a silver tray on his left hand. He is handing a glass of red wine to a lady in a green dress who sits opposite him. The lady in the green dress reaches out with her right hand to accept the glass. Next to her chair hangs a beige coat, draped casually over the backrest. A small potted fern sits on the windowsill behind the lady in the green dress, its leaves vibrant against the gray sky outside. To the right, an elderly man in a tweed cap reads a thick book, his glasses perched on his nose. A golden retriever lies on the floor next to the elderly man, its head resting on its paws. The dog looks at a child in a yellow shirt who is kneeling nearby. The child in the yellow shirt plays with a wooden toy train on the carpeted floor. Behind the child, a mother in a floral blouse watches attentively, her hands clasped together. A businessman in a gray suit types on a laptop placed on the table in front of him. His tie is loosened, suggesting a long day of travel. Next to the businessman, a briefcase sits closed on the adjacent seat. A young couple shares a plate of pastries at a distant table; the man in a denim jacket feeds a bite to the woman in a pink sweater. There is no digital clock on the wall. There is no plastic cutlery anywhere in the scene. There is no modern smartphone visible in anyone's hands.
